data.name: Lindie
data.gender_notes: Lindie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Lindisfarne, an English island associated with St. Aidan, who brought Christianity to the Anglo-Saxons. The name may mean 'light' or 'fragrant'. In the Bible, Linden trees are mentioned in Song of Solomon. The name Lindie carries the meaning “Light, Fragrant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lindie usually hope their child will grow to embody light, fragrant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light and fragrance in one's spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Lindie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Fragrant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lindie total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

The name's potential meaning, 'light', emphasizes the spiritual journey and enlightenment that followers of Christianity seek. The connection to Lindisfarne and St. Aidan, as well as the supposed meaning of 'light' or 'fragrant', can serve as powerful reminders of the transformative and uplifting qualities of faith and spiritual growth.
